components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action uses the selected page accent with a clear keyboard focus state.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-2); min-height: 44px; padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-5); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--page-cta); color: #fff; font: 600 var(--text-sm)/1.2 var(--font-body); transition: filter var(--transition), transform var(--transition); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--page-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Homepage Primary Button
components.description: Homepage hero and conversion-card pill CTA with Vurgu Mercanı and a soft shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-home-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-6); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--page-cta); color: #fff; font: 600 var(--text-base)/1.2 var(--font-body); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(90, 55, 30, 0.2); transition: filter var(--transition), transform var(--transition); } .ds-btn-home-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.9); } .ds-btn-home-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--page-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-home-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.css: .ds-grade-paths { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--space-4); } .ds-grade-paths article { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-4); padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-5); border: 1px solid #ead3bd; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: #fffaf5; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); } .ds-grade-paths .path-coral { --path-accent: var(--accent-coral); --path-accent-soft: var(--accent-coral-soft); } .ds-grade-paths .path-emerald { --path-accent: var(--accent-emerald); --path-accent-soft: var(--accent-emerald-soft); } .ds-grade-paths h2 { color: var(--path-accent); } .ds-grade-paths a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: var(--space-2); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--path-accent-soft); color: var(--color-text); } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-grade-paths { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

components.name: Homepage Success Message
components.description: Emerald completion panel for celebratory success, separate from correct-answer feedback.
components.css: .ds-success-message { max-width: calc(100vw - 2rem); margin-inline: 1rem; padding: 0.8rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--accent-emerald); border-radius: 1rem; background: var(--accent-emerald); color: #fff; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 1rem + 1vw, 1.75rem); line-height: 1.2; text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(58, 38, 24, 0.28); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-5); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: transparent; color: var(--color-text); font: 600 var(--text-sm)/1.2 var(--font-body); transition: background var(--transition), border-color var(--transition); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-surface-offset); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Registration field with a warm border and explicit focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); font: inherit; transition: border-color var(--transition); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(125, 90, 60, 0.3); border-color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact pill label using the selected page's soft accent tone and fixed cocoa text.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-1); padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--page-accent-soft); color: var(--color-text); font: 600 var(--text-xs)/1.3 var(--font-body); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--page-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Paper-toned container for grouped lesson or account content.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: var(--space-5); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0 0 var(--space-2); font: 600 var(--text-lg)/1.15 var(--font-display); } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--color-text-muted); font: 400 var(--text-sm)/1.6 var(--font-body); }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Muted, horizontally spaced links beneath a translucent sticky header.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-5); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.4 var(--font-body); color: var(--color-text-muted); } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: color var(--transition); } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible { color: var(--color-text); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }

narrative.overview:
ZarifÇözüm's interface keeps warm paper-like surfaces, cocoa headings, and the existing logo fixed while assigning one of three accents by learning context: coral for entry and grades 5–8, emerald for progress and grades 9–12, and cobalt for lessons, live classes, and the learning assistant. The intended feeling is warm, calm, and trustworthy rather than a cold technology aesthetic.

The shared stylesheet and homepage have related but distinct implementations. Shared page display headings use Clash Display; the homepage switches its headings to a Georgia-led serif and may combine the three role-scoped accents. Preserve those as observed surface variations rather than flattening them into one invented component style.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream and cocoa form the visual foundation.
Serif display type and sans-serif reading text create the main hierarchy.
Rounded controls, paper-toned cards, and soft ambient shadows keep the interface approachable.
New work is mobile-first and favors clear, breathable layouts.

rules.name: The Warm Paper Rule
rules.body: Keep the cream-and-cocoa identity recognizable across surfaces; distinguish page-specific token overrides instead of silently normalizing them.

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Use one page accent at a time; the homepage is the only multi-accent exception and scopes colors to their assigned roles.

rules.name: The Feedback Color Rule
rules.body: Correct and incorrect answer feedback uses fixed semantic tokens, independent of the page accent.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Keep the serif homepage display and the shared Clash Display heading stack as distinct existing roles; do not apply the homepage override globally without an explicit redesign.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Use a soft shadow to clarify a surface or interaction state, never as a dark decorative effect.

dos: Do preserve the existing ZarifÇözüm logo and cream/chestnut identity.
Do build new surfaces mobile-first and leave enough breathing room around learning content.
Do use mathematics-themed hand-drawn illustrations such as rulers, set squares, and graph paper when useful.
Do use subtle, purposeful animation and respect reduced-motion preferences.
Do keep color variants and typography overrides scoped to the surfaces where the code currently uses them.
donts: Don't shift the product into a cold blue-purple technology aesthetic.
Don't use hard dark shadows, neon colors, or crowded, high-density layouts.
Don't use success, warning, error, or live colors as decorative substitutes for the warm brand palette.
Don't flatten the homepage's serif and pill-button treatment into every shared page without an explicit redesign.
